name: plan-sharing
description: Captures the plan produced in Codex Plan Mode into the current Syns repo and warns when it overlaps another agent's plan in that repo.

interface.shortDescription: Share Plan Mode plans and detect cross-agent conflicts.
interface.longDescription: When a Codex turn ends in Plan Mode, captures the <proposed_plan> block, saves it into the current Syns repo's plans/ folder (pull, write, push), and compares it against the other plans there. On a conflict it asks the agent to revise or report before exiting Plan Mode. Silent no-op outside a Syns repo or outside Plan Mode.
